latest_release.name: Release v6.7.16.0
latest_release.body:
## System requirements
* tested on PHP `8.2`, `8.4` and `8.5`
* tested on `MySQL 8`, `MySQL 9.7`, `MariaDB 11` and `MariaDB 12`

## Critical Fixes

### Theme configuration updates reach all descendants

Saving a base theme now updates inherited runtime configuration and recompiles assigned descendant themes at every inheritance level.
Child and grandchild themes no longer require a separate save after changing their base theme, and descendant-specific overrides are preserved.
Deactivating or uninstalling a base theme is also blocked while any descendant theme or theme copy is assigned to a sales channel.
The error identifies the affected themes and sales channels; remove or replace those assignments before removing the base theme.

### Content Security Policy for static HTML and SVG assets on Apache

The Apache `.htaccess.dist` template now sends `script-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'` for existing `.html` files under `public/media` and `public/thumbnail`, and for SVG files.
Application-rendered HTML and bundled HTML applications retain their existing behavior.
Ensure your deployed `.htaccess` contains the updated Shopware section; installations without the Shopware update markers must merge it manually.
Custom static documents must work without scripts, embedded documents, base URL overrides or form submissions; images and styles remain permitted.

### Sales channel contexts expose the default currency again

`SalesChannelContext::getSalesChannel()->getCurrency()` returns the sales channel's default currency again, including when another currency is selected for the context. This restores the behavior before 6.7.15.0 for extensions that read the default currency. Use `SalesChannelContext::getCurrency()` for the currently selected currency.

### Line item conditions evaluate line items by the data they carry

Since 6.7.14.0, most line item conditions of the Rule Builder evaluated only line items of the type `product`. Custom and credit line items and line items that extensions add to the cart no longer matched them, and a single custom line item could hide shipping methods or block promotions under a negated condition such as "Item with tag / All / Are none of".

The conditions now evaluate a line item by the data it carries instead of by its type, so line items of any type work with the built-in conditions again, with no change needed in extensions.

### "Item with price/list price ratio" no longer matches line items without a list price

Since 6.7.9.0, the Rule Builder condition "Item with price/list price ratio" treated line items without a list price as having a ratio of `0`.
Conditions such as "Is less than 1" therefore also matched every line item without a list price,
so promotions meant for reduced products applied to all products.

Line items without a list price no longer have a ratio, so only the operators "Is not equal to" and "Is empty" match them.
If you used "Is equal to 0" to target line items without a list price, use "Is empty" instead.

## Features

### Digital products can use external file assignment

In the Administration, digital products can be saved without uploaded files when file assignment is handled externally. When editing a product, the option is enabled by default if it has no downloads and disabled if it has downloads.

### System configuration tabs

With the newly added tabs feature, plugin developers can now add another layer of organization to the already existing cards in the system configuration. This allows to group related cards into individual tabs and provide a better overview for merchants when configuring a plugin. The feature is fully optional to use and works with partial usage as well - any cards not added to a tab are automatically gathered in a "General" tab.

Example can be found [here](https://github.com/shopware/shopware/blob/v6.7.16.0/RELEASE_INFO-6.7.md#system-configuratio

detail.readme:
Build the commerce experience you imagine.

A complete open-source commerce foundation.
The freedom to shape your brand, your workflows, and your next idea.

Find your starting point · Try Shopware · Run locally · Developer docs

![Shopware connects your brand and custom journeys to an extensible commerce foundation.](https://images.ctfassets.net/nqzs8zsepqpi/7hZV2gVJ9y7hKWzwUFpyq6/0cc0755368da55afba5c7da51860edba/hero.svg) ## Your vision should shape your software. Not the other way around. A distinctive brand needs more than a familiar checkout. It needs room to tell its story, express its personality, and turn a good idea into an experience customers remember. Shopware gives you a complete commerce foundation **and the source code to make it your own**. Start with a working storefront, catalog, cart, checkout, and administration. Then build the product advisor, configurator, integration, or buying journey your business calls for. | Why Shopware | What that means for your project | | :--- | :--- | | **Make the experience unmistakably yours** | Combine Shopping Experiences, custom themes, or an API-driven frontend. | | **Build on a complete foundation** | Focus on what makes your business different rather than rebuilding commerce basics. | | **Keep control of your next move** | Extend the MIT-licensed core, choose compatible hosting, and decide how external services use your data. | | **Build with your preferred coding agent** | Let agents inspect code and propose changes while you review, test, and deploy them. | ## See what makes Shopware different These conceptual illustrations show possibilities, not recordings of the administration or promises of one-click features. ### A brand people remember Bring product discovery and your brand's story together with Shopping Experiences, themes, and custom frontends. ![Conceptual animation of a branded storefront.](https://images.ctfassets.net/nqzs8zsepqpi/73c0XXwIzdFYtooz3wl1PC/143893b2dbaeb96fb47420865436e586/brand-experience.gif) [Static view](https://images.ctfassets.net/nqzs8zsepqpi/1jFqi3uhub8Gl98TikRmu5/521b8024bfbe25a0412913fcf307b1ea/brand-experience.png) · [Explore Shopping Experiences](https://docs.shopware.com/en/shopware-6-en/content/ShoppingExperiences) ### Commerce that works the way you do Connect events, rules, and actions to automate repetitive workflows and make more time for customers and new ideas. ![Conceptual animation of an order event and automated workflow.](https://images.ctfassets.net/nqzs8zsepqpi/5jbiiztjDGyLjcFOY6QXCI/ae171aa25a57dc043587fb42c273a5a7/commerce-automation.gif) [Static view](https://images.ctfassets.net/nqzs8zsepqpi/3I95s0yH84hM2fXySHR0LX/7994d89814830e47d74c9d1135732323/commerce-automation.png) · [Explore Flow Builder](https://docs.shopware.com/en/shopware-6-en/settings/Flow-Builder) ### Open code. Your ideas. Your choice of agent. Use your preferred coding agent to explore the implementation, develop extensions, and run tests. You remain in control of code review and deployment. ![Conceptual animation of AI-assisted extension development.](https://images.ctfassets.net/nqzs8zsepqpi/6aILrGj4PcNg4lPtQKCqYt/d9618fc7a7597d76549ee80306ec7c68/build-with-agents.gif) [Static view](https://images.ctfassets.net/nqzs8zsepqpi/aRrjke0J9mBUAwMYrO8H6/48419951c5c4c94f6284dd947eea1222/build-with-agents.png) · [Agent instructions](https://github.com/shopware/shopware/blob/trunk/AGENTS.md) ## Choose your starting point Different projects need different first steps. Pick the path that fits what you want to do. | I want to… | Start here | What to expect | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Explore Shopware** | [Create a demo store](https://hub.shopware.com/build) | Try a hosted shop without local installation. The demo has limitations. | | **Build my own shop** | [Run Shopware locally](#run-shopware-locally) | Create a development project with the Shopware CLI and Docker. | | **Build an extension or theme** | [Explore extension guides](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/plugins/) | Choose between apps, plugins, themes, and API-based frontends. Scaffold a plugin or theme with `shopware-cli extension create`, then add example features with `shopware-cli extension add`. | | **Contribute to Shopware core** | [Read the contribution guide](https://github.com/shopware/shopware/blob/trunk/CONTRIBUTING.md) | Follow the upstream contribution workflow, which differs from a merchant project. | **Curious about an experimental alternative?** A [community browser playground](https://agentic-commerce-lab.github.io/shopware-claude-commerce/) runs a Shopware demonstration using WebAssembly. It is a separate experiment, not the official hosted demo or production hosting. Optional agent features may require your own API key and provider charges. ![The tech stack of Shopware](https://images.ctfassets.net/nqzs8zsepqpi/3KlOrjRWXHaZn6TMQP2WQ6/dc79b4b08602684d2d65b25e30d1ce3a/hero-tech.svg) ## Why developers choose Shopware **Own your stack. No vendor lock-in.** The MIT-licensed core runs wherever you choose to host it, and your code, data, and extensions stay yours. Development happens in the open on GitHub, so you can follow every change, see where the platform is heading, and contribute your own solutions back. Under the hood, Shopware is a Symfony application with a Vue.js administration, a Twig storefront, and APIs and extension points throughout the platform. | Part | Technology | | :--- | :--- | | Backend | PHP, Symfony, Doctrine DBAL | | Storefront | Twig, Bootstrap | | Administration | Vue, TypeScript | | Data | MySQL or MariaDB; Shopware Data Abstraction Layer | | Integrations | Store API and Admin API | Exact supported versions depend on the Shopware release. See the [installation requirements](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/installation/requirements.html). Shopware supports different extension models: | Approach | Use it for | Deployment note | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Theme** | Change storefront presentation and templates | Supported implementation differs by hosting model. | | **App** | Integrate external services using APIs and webhooks | Runs outside the Shopware core. | | **Plugin** | Add in-process PHP/Symfony behavior | Requires a compatible self-hosted deployment. | | **Headless frontend** | Build a custom shopping experience with the Store API | Uses the shop's sales-channel APIs. | [Compare extension options](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/plugins/) · [Explore Shopware Frontends](https://frontends.shopware.com/) ## Run Shopware locally We recommend the [Shopware CLI](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/products/tools/cli/) to create, develop, build, and validate your Shopware projects and extensions, with plenty more built-in features. Its interactive dashboard shows credentials, health checks, live logs, and more. The recommended Docker setup adds a production-like environment and lets you run several Shopware versions side by side, each on its own local HTTPS hostname. **[Start Shopware in minutes →](https://developer.shopware.com/)** Install the Shopware CLI, create a project, and open your shop, with step-by-step instructions. The [installation guide](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/installation/) provides more details. This setup is for local development. Ready to go live? See the [hosting guide](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/hosting/). Can't use Docker? Choose PHP and Composer when creating your project, and the Shopware CLI still handles the installation. ## Extend Shopware your way Choose the extension point that fits your project. For example, a storefront theme or plugin can override a Twig block without replacing the entire template: ```twig {% sw_extends '@Storefront/storefront/component/buy-widget/buy-widget.html.twig' %} {% block buy_widget_price %} {{ parent() }}

Ships within 24 hours

{% endblock %} ``` This is an illustrative snippet; follow the [theme guides](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/plugins/themes/) for a complete implementation. For integrations, use the [Admin API](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/integrations-api/) or [Store API](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/integrations-api/), depending on the task. ## Build with your preferred coding agent Open source makes implementation details available to both developers and their tools. Coding agents can read project code, [agent instructions](https://github.com/shopware/shopware/blob/trunk/AGENTS.md), and [development skills](https://github.com/shopware/shopware/tree/trunk/.agents/skills) to help create and test extensions. The [Shopware CLI](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/products/tools/cli/) helps you discover Shopware AI tooling: run `shopware-cli ai list` to see the available agent skills and MCP servers, and `shopware-cli ai add` to install one into your coding agent. More integrations are on the way. A useful first task: ```text Read the project's agent instructions and identify the Shopware version. Help me build a small plugin for a gift-message feature. First explain the supported extension points and the data flow. Do not edit vendor files or core source. Propose a minimal implementation, include a meaningful test, and show me how to disable the plugin again. ``` Review and test generated changes before deployment. A **coding agent** working with project files is different from an **administrative agent** connected to a running shop. Learn about the [Shopware MCP server](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/products/tools/mcp-server/) and the separate [Agentic Commerce project](https://github.com/shopware/agentic-commerce); access depends on configuration and permissions. ## Open source, with clear choices The [Shopware core is MIT-licensed](https://github.com/shopware/shopware/blob/trunk/LICENSE). You can inspect, modify, and self-host it under that license. Hosting, commercial plans, Shopware Account and Store services, extensions, and external AI or payment providers may have separate terms and costs. Review the [Community Edition Fair Usage Policy](https://www.shopware.com/en/news/fair-usage-policy-community-edition/) and [current plans](https://www.shopware.com/en/pricing/) when choosing a deployment model. ## Build with the community You don't need to write a major feature to contribute. Improve a guide, reproduce a bug, translate Shopware, add a test, or share what you built. - **Ask and share:** [Community Hub](https://hub.shopware.com/) · [Discord](https://chat.shopware.com/) · [Forum](https://forum.shopware.com/) - **Contribute code:** [Contribution guide](https://github.com/shopware/shopware/blob/trunk/CONTRIBUTING.md) - **Report issues:** [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/shopware/shopware/issues) - **Suggest improvements:** [Feedback portal](https://feedback.shopware.com/) - **Report security concerns privately:** [Security policy](https://github.com/shopware/shopware/blob/trunk/SECURITY.md) - **Follow new releases:** [Releases](https://github.com/shopware/shopware/releases) > Like what we're doing? Give us a star! ⭐ ## Thanks to all our contributors ![Shopware contributor avatars](https://contributors-img.web.app/image?repo=shopware/shopware&max=96) --- **Your next idea deserves room to grow.** [Try Shopware](https://hub.shopware.com/build) · [Run locally](#run-shopware-locally) · [Read the docs](https://developer.shopware.com/) · [Join the community](https://hub.shopware.com/)
